sources.quote: 42 Draconis, formally named Fafnir, is a 5th magnitude K-type giant star located approximately 295 light-years away in the constellation of Draco.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 138 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,473 K, so 19.571 solar radii.
